## 

Load libraries

```{r}
# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(maps)
library(mapdata)
library(mapproj)

```

Load data

```{r}
# Population in California by county
popdata <- read_csv(here("Week_07", "Data", "CApopdata.csv"))

# Seastar counts at field sites in California
stars <- read_csv(here("Week_07", "Data", "stars.csv"))
```

Check out map data

```{r}
world <- map_data("world")

head(world)
```

Map out the USA
```{r}
usa <- map_data("usa")

head(usa)
```

Map out the states

```{r}
states <- map_data("state")

head(states)
```

Check out a specific country
```{r}
Italy <- map_data("italy")

head(Italy)
```

**DO NOT FORGET TO ADD GROUP = GROUP IN YOUR MAP CODE!**

Make a map of the world
```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = world,
               aes(x = long, y = lat,
                   group = group))
```

**THIS IS WHAT HAPPENS IF YOU FORGET TO ADD GROUP = GROUP IN YOUR MAP CODE!**
```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = world,
               aes(x = long, y = lat,))
```
Add things to map

```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = world,
               aes(x = long, y = lat,
                   group = group,
                   fill = region),
               color = "black") +
  theme_minimal() +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  theme(panel.background =
          element_rect(fill = "lightblue")) +
  coord_map(projection = "mercator",
            xlim  = c(-180,180))
```
Map of just California
```{r}
# Filter the states dataframe to just CA
California <- states |> 
  filter(region == "california")

ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = California,
               aes(x = long, y = lat,
                   group = group),
               fill = "#BA0C2F",
               color = "black") +
  theme_minimal() +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  labs(x = "Longitude (deg)", y = "Latitude (deg)") +
  theme(panel.background =
          element_rect(fill = "white"))+
  coord_map(projection = "mercator")
```

Map with counties in California 

```{r}
counties <- map_data("county")

CApop_county <- popdata |> 
  select("subregion" = County, Population) |> 
  inner_join(counties) |> 
  filter(region == "california")
```

```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = CApop_county,
               aes(x = long, y = lat,
                   group = group, 
                   fill = Population),
               color = "black") +
                 coord_map() +
              scale_fill_gradient(transform = "log10")
```
Add stars
```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = CApop_county,
               aes(x = long, y = lat,
                   group = group, 
                   fill = Population),
               color = "black") +
  geom_point(data = stars,
             aes(x = long, y = lat,
             size = star_no)) +
                 coord_map() +
              scale_fill_gradient(transform = "log10") +
  labs(size = "# stars/m2")

ggsave(here("Week_07", "Output", "CApop.png"))
```
